title: Adherence

gate.name: Before the trade
gate.hint: Were you allowed to take this trade at all — time, news, risk, regime.

setup.name: The setup itself
setup.hint: Did the chart really show this setup? These criteria belong to the strategy.

exit.name: Managing the trade
exit.hint: What you did with the position once it was open.

state.todo: Not reviewed yet — counts towards nothing until you confirm it.
state.done: Reviewed. Unticked criteria count as missed.

chip.none: {block}: no criteria on this trade's date

coverage: reviewed on {scored} of {total, plural, one {# trade} other {# trades}}

queue.remaining: {count, plural, one {# more after this} other {# more after this}}

window.open: Open for another {left} — it follows your current criteria until then.
window.locked: Review closed. Later changes to your criteria don't reach it.

pending.note: Added after this review closed — not scored here.
pending.blockOnly: All added after this review closed — nothing to score.

needsStrategy: Pick the setup you traded and its checklist appears here. Without one there is nothing to measure against.
noCriteria: No criteria in this block yet.

verdict.noData: Nothing reviewed yet — review a trade and the diagnosis starts here.
verdict.gate: Fix your entry discipline first. You're taking trades you shouldn't.
verdict.setup: Discipline is fine — you're misreading the chart. Look at the setup criteria.
verdict.exit: You pick the trades well and then lose them. Everything after the entry is what's costing you.
verdict.playbook: All three hold and you're still losing, over enough trades to mean it. Time to change the playbook.
verdict.smallSample: A losing stretch this short means nothing yet. Change nothing for another {remaining, plural, one {# trade} other {# trades}}.
verdict.thin: {block} looks low, but on too few trades to be sure. Review {remaining, plural, one {# more} other {# more}} first.
verdict.clean: All three hold and you're making money. Keep doing exactly this.
verdict.stat: {block}: {pct}% over {count, plural, one {# trade} other {# trades}} · target {target}%
verdict.playbookStat: Negative expectancy over {trades, plural, one {# trade} other {# trades}}

sample.needMore: {remaining, plural, one {# more reviewed trade} other {# more reviewed trades}} before these numbers say anything.

scope.label: Filtered by:
scope.more: {count, plural, one {+# more filter} other {+# more filters}}

noTradesInFilter.title: No closed trades in the current filter
noTradesInFilter.description: Your criteria are set up — widen the filter to see them at work.

noSetupsShown.title: Every setup is hidden
noSetupsShown.description: Tick a setup back on to see its figures.

table.separatedNote: Highlighted rows keep their two win rates apart despite the small sample. Worth a look, not a verdict.

missed.title: Most often skipped
missed.empty: Nothing stands out yet — a criterion appears once you've skipped it a few times.

trend.title: Adherence over time
trend.hint: Your daily average per block, oldest to newest. Only days you reviewed something appear.
trend.hintGrouped: Averaged in {days}-day steps to keep the range readable. Only days you reviewed something appear.
trend.empty: Review a few trades and the trend starts here.

perStrategy.title: By strategy
perStrategy.empty: No strategies with closed trades yet.

criteria.subtitle: The yes/no checks each trade is measured against. Changes apply from today on.

needsStrategy.title: Create a strategy first
needsStrategy.description: Criteria describe how a strategy is traded, so there has to be one to attach them to.

criteria.universalLead: Written once, applied to all your strategies.
criteria.perStrategyLead: Checks only this strategy is measured against, on top of the universal ones.

form.label: Criterion
form.labelPlaceholder: One thing you can answer yes or no to
form.labelHint: Keep it to a single check — if two things can fail, make it two criteria.
form.definitionPlaceholder: Optional — the detail you'd otherwise argue with yourself about
form.modeFixHint: Past trades keep counting towards it.
form.modeReplaceHint: The old one retires today and a new one starts. Past trades keep the old wording.

delete.title: Retire this criterion?
delete.body: {name} stops applying from today. Past trades keep it, so their adherence doesn't change.

window.label: Entry fell inside my trading window
window.definition: The hours you decided in advance to trade.

news.definition: No high-impact release within a few minutes either side of the entry.
news.label: No high-impact news around the entry

regime.label: Market regime allows this setup today
regime.definition: You named the regime before entering, and this setup is one you allow yourself in it.

location.label: Entry sat at a level I can name
location.definition: A level marked in advance, not a price you noticed while watching.

target.label: Target was at least the minimum R from the stop
target.definition: Measured against the planned stop, before entering.

size.label: Position size matched the plan
size.definition: Risk per trade inside the range you set for yourself.

thesis.label: Thesis written down in one sentence
thesis.definition: Location, context, trigger — written before the entry.

stopStructure.label: Stop sat on structure from the start
stopStructure.definition: Placed where the idea is wrong, not at a round number or a fixed distance.

stopHeld.label: Stop never moved against the position
stopHeld.definition: Moving to breakeven or trailing is fine. Giving the trade more room is not.

targetHeld.label: Target never moved further away
targetHeld.definition: Pushing the target out mid-trade is the same mistake as widening the stop.

noAdding.label: Nothing added to a losing position
noAdding.definition: Planned scale-ins are fine; adding because it went against you is not.

plannedClose.label: Closed for a reason I had planned
plannedClose.definition: Stop, target, or the thesis being dead. Not boredom, not a feeling, not the clock.

toast.seeded: Template added — edit anything that doesn't fit

empty.title: No criteria yet
empty.description: Adherence checks each trade against a short list of yes/no criteria, in three groups: before the trade, the setup itself, and how you managed it. Write a few — or start from the template — and every trade you review becomes a data point.
